people.name: Abiah
people.line: Wife of Hezron, who gave birth after he died

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah

people.name: Ephrathah
people.line: A wife of Caleb and founder of Bethlehem.

people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
translations.bsb: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
translations.kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
translations.asv: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron's wife bare him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
